description: Réthoré, Pierre-Elouan and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed historical TOPFARM applications evaluate Middelgrunden and the Stags Holt/Coldham setting using production, fatigue and financial trade-offs. The source reports positive financial balances of approximately EUR 2.1 million and EUR 3.1 million in its stated comparisons. A Middelgrunden energy-value figure of EUR 9.3 million is partly offset by grid-related costs. These optimisation results do not establish realised revenue. Historical TOPFARM is named without assigning the case to the modern TopFarm2 package, whose exact lineage remains unresolved. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-sa-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
